svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
a rail fence of 3 rails: the message zigzags down and up across three lines, then each line is read left to right, top line first
rail 1 holds 25 letters, rail 2 48, rail 3 24; place 22 is on rail 2
where each known letter lands, and the carved letter there
E of place 22, the 11th letter on rail 2, comes out 25 + 11 = 36th, on the copper's T
12,784 rail settings (2 to 6 rails, any start, any rail order) x 8 tables
OUT: NO READING; EVERY COUNT INSIDE THE SCRAMBLED COPPERS' RANGE
